name: OpenID Connect Single Sign-on
description: Sign users in through an OpenID Connect identity provider such as Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia or Entra ID. Users get a Matinee account on first sign-in, and an existing local account of the same username is linked to its identity.
author: Michael André Reber

config.label: Name shown on the login button
config.description: The login page shows "Sign in with" followed by this name. Default is the plugin name.

config.label: Issuer URL
config.description: The provider's issuer, for example https://auth.example.com/realms/home. Its /.well-known/openid-configuration document is read from there.

config.label: Client secret
config.description: Register Matinee as a confidential web client with the redirect URI shown by the Check issuer button.

config.label: Scopes
config.description: Default openid profile email. Add groups when the administrator group is set and the provider needs the scope for the claim.

config.label: Username claim
config.description: Default preferred_username. The claim becomes the Matinee username, so an existing local account of the same name is linked.

config.label: Groups claim
config.description: Default groups. A list claim that carries the user's group names.

config.label: Administrator group
config.description: Members of this group become Matinee administrators and everyone else is demoted on sign-in. Leave empty to manage the admin flag in Matinee.

config.label: Accept self-signed certificates
config.description: Skips certificate verification for the provider. Only for a provider whose certificate is not signed by a CA this server trusts.

config.label: Check issuer
config.description: Reads the discovery document and shows the redirect URI to register at the provider.
